newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-year yields end flat in mixed trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-year yields end flat in mixed trading.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed flat on Tuesday as early institutional buying was eroded by late profit-taking, brokers said.
Three-month CD yields fell on the back of a fund shift from long-term bond investment. The overnight call rates closed unchanged with banks sticking to their daily routine deals.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.52 pct, flat from Monday
* Overnight call average 13.0 pct, unchanged from Monday
